title: His Dead Grandpa Sent Him A Watch . . . Then Aliens Came For It

segments.say: An alien bounty hunter just told Ben he would sell him for *human meat*.
And it all started with a gift from his *dead* grandpa.
Ben Tennyson, fifteen. A few months ago, he lost his grandpa *Max*.
Max was everything to him. His coach, his hero, the guy who never missed a *game*.
Now Ben quit *baseball*. He stopped talking. His parents had no idea how to help.
Then his cousin *Gwen* stepped in.
She said he can't hide forever, and dragged him on a family *camping* trip.
The night before they left, Ben found a box in his room. It said, *from Max*.
Inside was a letter. Remember, the sky isn't the limit for us Tennysons. We aim for the *stars*.
And a tiny piece of *moon rock*. Ben broke down and cried.
At camp, Gwen found him alone by the lake.
She said she missed Grandpa too. But Ben *snapped*. Clearly, he wasn't yours.
Gwen walked away hurt. Ben looked up and said, I wish I could talk to you *again*.
And right then, a *fireball* came out of the sky.
It crashed right next to him. *Boom*.
In the crater sat a glowing pod. Ben touched it, and it said, *DNA target located*.
A watch jumped out and locked onto his wrist. It *burned* like fire.
He pressed the dial, and his whole body *changed*.
Ben was now a blue alien that could run faster than *lightning*.
He could not stop. He shot across the cliffs, onto the road, and straight at a speeding *truck*.
The driver screamed. His brakes were *gone*.
Then Ben heard Grandpa's voice in his head. Stay calm. Trust yourself, even when you're *scared*.
Three. Two. One. He ran at the truck and pulled the driver *out*.
The truck *exploded* behind them.
But Gwen heard the crash. She went to check, and found something else in the *dark*.
A giant alien *bounty hunter*. And he was looking for the watch.
He grabbed Gwen and said, help me find the Omnitrix, and I'll help you find your cousin.
Gwen *punched* him in the face.
Far away, Ben's watch turned red, and he was *human* again.
Then Aunt Natalie called. Gwen was *missing*.
Ben found her phone on the ground. And then, *boom*.
The hunter, *Kraab*, yelled, come out kid! I'm done waiting on this stinky planet.
Ben said, I need to get help. Then he stopped. Maybe I *am* the help.
Kraab fired a giant laser. Ben slammed the watch and *vanished* in the smoke.
This time he was a black alien with long *cables* for arms.
Kraab laughed. After all this waiting, I'm owed some *fun*.
He threw Ben around like a toy, stabbed his own cable into him, and *electrocuted* him.
Meanwhile, Gwen was trapped in a burning *cabin*.
She closed her eyes and said words she had only read in books. And the door *shattered*.
Gwen had *magic*.
Kraab beat Ben down and said, the watch has bonded to you. So I have to take *you* with it.
Then he saw Gwen running away, and aimed right at her.
Ben screamed *no*. His cables caught Kraab's blast, and drank the *energy*.
Then he fired it all back in one giant *beam*.
Kraab burned. Ben dropped to his knees, and the watch beeped *red*.
Gwen found him. Ben hid his arm and lied. I'm fine, just a scratch.
But behind them, the burnt Kraab twitched, and sent a *signal* into space.
Far away, on the planet *Galvan Prime*, someone got the message.
The Omnitrix was supposed to be *destroyed*. Along with its maker, and Max Tennyson.
Back home, Ben became a *hero*. He hit the home run that won the championship.
His family cheered. He looked at the empty chair, and smiled. *Grandpa*.
But every night, Ben had *nightmares*. Kraab kept coming back.
Deep in space, a scarred alien warlord, half *machine* now, traced the signal. Soon the Omnitrix would be his. Ben 10 fans, you know *who* this is.
One night, Ben was late getting home. So he used the watch, and grew *wings*.
He flew over the city laughing. Maybe this thing isn't so bad after all.
Then something *slammed* into him from the sky.
A blue alien stood over him. He said, my name is *Rook*.
Your grandfather was my partner. And it's my *fault* he's dead.
So how did Grandpa Max really die? And why did his watch come looking for *Ben*? Comment part two if you want more.
